scientific_integrity: The fixed-locus factorization and j-invariant reductions are checked by exact rational polynomial arithmetic. The CM-discriminant labels are supported by a standard CM j-invariant table. A closely related finite-field cubic-AGM preprint was available only at abstract level, and that access limitation is retained as a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns literal equality of the Hesse parameter across one cubic-AGM 3-isogeny step over the complex numbers. It does not classify isomorphic-but-differently-parameterized targets, longer cycles, or finite-field dynamics.
title: Diagonal fixed points of the cubic-AGM Hesse 3-isogeny
